content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital products

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle provide streamlined payment processing and automatic delivery of digital products, but they impose significant limitations based on geographic location. Stripe's extensive features are offset by its lack of availability in many regions, while PayPal can suspend accounts and freeze funds for up to 180 days without recourse. Alternatives like Gumroad and Paddle suffer similar restrictions, leaving creators in affected countries with few options. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure, like what COREMERCH offers, provides an all-inclusive stack that empowers creators without these geographical constraints. This architecture ensures full ownership of products and customer data, all while bypassing platform fees and limitations.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional payment platforms often exclude users in various countries due to regulatory compliance, risk management, or economic viability. Stripe's operations are limited to a select few regions, leaving many creators unable to utilize its services. PayPal's terms often lead to account suspensions in high-risk areas, proving unreliable for consistent cash flow. In contrast, sovereign commerce solutions, like COREMERCH's offerings, are accessible to creators in restricted countries. By leveraging decentralized payment systems like NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with low transaction fees, creators can confidently sell products without worrying about arbitrary restrictions or account freezes.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed and fees significantly impact a creator's bottom line. Traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal often charge high fees, ranging from 2.9% plus $0.30 per transaction, and can take days to process payments. Additionally, unexpected account suspensions can result in cash flow disruptions. On the other hand, sovereign commerce architecture minimizes fees to a mere 0.5% with NOWPayments. Transactions can also be processed in under five minutes, ensuring creators receive their funds promptly. This efficiency, coupled with no hidden fees or penalties for account inactivity, positions sovereign solutions as the superior choice for creators aiming for profitability.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure eliminates the risk of account freezes.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership and control over digital products are crucial for creators. Platforms like Gumroad and Paddle maintain control over customer data and have the right to change their terms at any time, creating uncertainty. In contrast, when you deploy a COREMERCH stack, you own the entire architecture and customer data from day one. This means no hidden fees, no subscriptions, and no reliance on third-party platforms. Automatic file delivery and payment verification ensure a seamless customer experience, allowing creators to focus on their craft rather than administrative hassles.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture depends on your specific needs and constraints. If you're in a country with severe restrictions on payment platforms, the COREMERCH Sovereign Starter Stack offers a straightforward deployment within 48 hours, enabling you to start selling with minimal effort. For more advanced needs, the Edge Commerce Stack provides enhanced features and scalability options. Alternatively, if you're uncertain, the Complete Builder Kit includes all blueprints and templates necessary to construct your digital commerce stack, ensuring you have the tools needed for success. This flexibility allows you to select the right solution for your unique situation.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
No hidden fees or subscriptions with COREMERCH — own your business outright.

Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
